parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO lepefy_n8n.digest_email_claims(idempotency_key,status,claimed_at,updated_at)
  VALUES ($1,'processing',now(),now())
  ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
    SET status='processing',claimed_at=now(),updated_at=now()
  WHERE lepefy_n8n.digest_email_claims.status='failed'
     OR (lepefy_n8n.digest_email_claims.status='processing'
         AND lepefy_n8n.digest_email_claims.claimed_at < now()-interval '30 minutes')
  RETURNING 'claimed'::text AS claim_status
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT claim_status FROM claimed LIMIT 1),
  (SELECT CASE WHEN status='accepted' THEN 'duplicate' ELSE 'busy' END
   FROM lepefy_n8n.digest_email_claims WHERE idempotency_key=$1 LIMIT 1),
  'busy'
) AS claim_status;
UPDATE lepefy_n8n.digest_email_claims SET status='accepted',accepted_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE idempotency_key=$1 AND status='processing' RETURNING idempotency_key,status;

parameters.jsCode: const row=$input.first()?.json; if (!row || row.status!=='accepted') throw new Error('Claim not marked accepted'); return [{json:{accepted:true,idempotencyKey:row.idempotency_key}}];
